The people of [[Lakeside County]] have discovered [[devourer]]s with [[Poisonous Stinger|poisonous stingers]]. Travel to their [[Devourer Cave|cave]] and get a stinger to take to [[Brother Mhenlo]], so that he can prepare an antidote.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = y
| minimum = 2
}}

===Objectives===
* Cross the river and destroy the [[Plague Devourer|plague devourer]] to get a poisonous stinger.
* Deliver the poisonous stinger to Brother Mhenlo in [[Ashford Abbey]].

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Healing Ankh]]
** [[Energy]] +3
** [[Health]] +10
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +5 (vs. [[physical damage]])

==Walkthrough==
Head south from [[Ascalon City (pre-Searing)|Ascalon City]] and cross the river to reach the island cave (which appears grey on your map). Go around the western side until you reach the cave's entrance near [[Duke Gaban]] and [[Fadden Hathorn]], and venture into the cave.

Although there are four more [[Carrion Devourer]]s in the cave during this quest than usual, you can ignore most of them and the [[Lash Devourer]]s, since they don't attack you unless a [[Diseased Devourer]] [[popup|pops up]]. When this happens, focus on Diseased Devourers first, since they are level 0 and will die in one or two basic hits.

The Plague Devourer is located near the end of the cave and will pop up and attack you once approached. Despite the dialogue, it cannot [[poison]] you. Once you have killed it, two poisonous stingers will drop. Collect one of them and map travel to Ashford Abbey to give it to Brother Mhenlo.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Baron Egan
:''"The devourer cave southwest of town has always been a source of danger to the people of Lakeside County, but they have learned to be vigilant and to defend themselves from the beasts. Unfortunately, I've been hearing recently of a new sort of devourer with a poisonous sting.''

:''"I'd like you to find one of these creatures, kill it, and take its '''Poisonous Stinger''' {{sic|poisonous stinger}} to '''Brother Mhenlo''' in Ashford Abbey."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = You can count on me.
| decline = I have my own troubles.
| ask = What seems to be the problem? Are you having trouble finding the cave or your courage? If you go southwest from town and then go south across the water at the first opportunity, you will find the island where the '''devourer cave''' is located. It should not be difficult to search the island for a cave entrance from there.
}}

===Intermittent dialogue===
;Baron Egan
:''"Don't give the stinger to me! I wouldn't know what to do with it. Follow the road southwest from town and go to Ashford Abbey. Brother Mhenlo will know how to study and make an antidote for its poison."''

===Reward dialogue===
;Brother Mhenlo
:''"Is the poisonous stinger intact? Yes, it's perfect, and there's enough here that I can begin work on an antidote."''

==Notes==
*Since a devourer has two tails, it will drop two stingers; however, only one of them is needed to complete the quest. The other one can be discarded or ignored.
